verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect is documented for building a platform or marketplace that moves money between multiple parties [stripe-docs-38]. It collects customer payments and automatically pays out a portion to sellers or service providers [stripe-docs-12]. Connected accounts are a first-class concept, including acting on a seller's behalf via the Stripe-Account header [stripe-supp-mcp-connected-accounts], and Stripe maintains Connect skills covering seller verification requirements [stripe-supp-skills-catalog]. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the seller onboarding/KYC flow, specifics of split-payment mechanics (application fees, transfers), per-seller payout scheduling, and independent hands-on corroboration of Connect.
